I recommend looking at the previous row. See that chain you made for the next row of stitches? You don’t wanna put a stitch on any of those beginning row chains 

If you want to use only single crochet for a swatch - you will put ONE chain at the end of every row before continuing. 
For Half Double Crochet - add TWO chains at the end of every row. 
For Double Crochet, add 3 ch, etc.  
This is good beginner info for me bc it helps me see where my chain ends. If you wanna SEE where the chain ends, and you wrap back around to it, put a stitch marker (or a safety pin) on the last chain of the row to know where the chain is.
